transcript: One of the most exciting new musicals I've seen in a while is currently having its world premiere production at Arena Stage in Washington, DC. It's called A wrinkle in time, based on the children's book of the same name. But despite being based on a children's book, it is incredibly dense. And a lot of that credit goes to Heather Christian, who has written a really complex score that is doing so many interesting things Musically. Seeing this show for the first time gave me that same feeling that I have when I listen to sometime for the first time or when I listen to Dave Malloy for the first time. There are just some composers that understand music on a whole other level, and Heather Christian is definitely one of them. It's one of those shows where you just immediately want a cast recording so you can start dissecting it, because there's just so much more going on than you could possibly pick up on your first watch. And because of that, I think this musical is not gonna be for everyone. It's not a very commercial piece of theater, which is to say, I wouldn't necessarily recommend it to someone who's never seen a musical before. But if you are someone who loves musical theater as an art form and love to see it pushed in new and exciting directions, then I think you're really gonna dig wrinkle in time. It's certainly not a perfect musical. I Mean, it is a world premiere production, so they're definitely still finding some things, but I think it has tremendous bones, and I cannot wait to see how it continues to evolve.
classificationReason: Creator reviews 'A Wrinkle in Time' musical at Arena Stage in Washington DC, praising Heather Christian's score, but this show is not on the provided list
